user.title: WLED Holiday Lights
user.description: Name this lighting setup and choose its WLED strip. Name WLED presets `[Theme] Look name`. The lights may run from sunset to midnight at first. After setup, choose **Configure** on this setup to change the lighting windows and add sources (calendars, conditions or templates) that request themes.

data_description.name: Used for the device and its entity IDs.
data_description.preset: The native WLED preset select entity; its options are the look library.
data_description.power: Optional outlet that powers the WLED controller. With an outlet, off means the outlet is switched off.

abort.already_configured: Another lighting setup already uses this WLED light or preset selector.

init.title: WLED Holiday Lights
init.description: The lights may run while any lighting window is open. Sources are checked from the top, and the first one with a usable theme wins. Drag to reorder, use the pencil to edit, or **Add** a new window or source. Each source also gets an on/off switch on the device.

data_description.power: Optional. Clear it if WLED isn't behind a switched outlet.
data_description.windows: Each window opens and closes at a clock time, or at sunrise or sunset plus an offset. Windows stay within one day; an end time of 00:00 is midnight. Overlapping windows combine. A window stays closed on days its end isn't after its start, or when the sun doesn't rise or set.
data_description.sources: **Calendar**: event titles are themes; the shortest event wins. **Condition**: requests the theme while the entity is on. **Template**: requests whatever the template renders.

reconcile.name: Re-check schedule
reconcile.description: Re-evaluate the schedule and correct anything WLED has drifted from. Target a lighting setup when there is more than one. Not available in Manual mode.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the schedule status and used for the source's on/off switch.

type.name: Type
type.description: Calendar, Condition or Template. Fill in only the fields below that this type uses.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: Calendar: the calendar. Condition: an entity that is on or off (binary sensor, input boolean, switch, schedule...).

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Condition only: the theme requested while the entity is on.

template.name: Template
template.description: Template only: renders a theme name, or nothing. Empty, `none`, `false`, `unknown` and `unavailable` request nothing.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shown in the In lighting hours attributes. Defaults to Window and its position.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the window opens: a clock time, or sunrise or sunset.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Time only: the clock time the window opens.

start_offset.name: Start offset
start_offset.description: Sunrise or Sunset only: minutes after the sun event; negative is before.

end.name: End
end.description: When the window closes: a clock time, or sunrise or sunset.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: Time only: the clock time the window closes. 00:00 is midnight at the end of the day.

end_offset.name: End offset
end_offset.description: Sunrise or Sunset only: minutes after the sun event; negative is before.
